question: _________________ recommend(s) 20 mm wide margins for sheet sizes AO and A1 in engineering drawings.
solution:
The correct answer is __Borders and frames: SP: 46 (2003)**(Option 3)**.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Borders and frames__ play a significant role in engineering drawings.
 
• SP: 46 (2003) specifies standard practices for technical drawings, including recommendations for margins and frames.
 
• For sheet sizes A0 and A1, 20 mm wide margins are recommended to ensure clarity and consistency in presentation.
 
• This standard is widely accepted and ensures uniformity in engineering documentation.
 
• Adhering to SP: 46 (2003) facilitates better communication and understanding between engineers and architects.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Grid reference system:**

 
 
• Used to provide a coordinate-based system for referencing specific locations on a drawing.
 
• Helps engineers locate details efficiently.
 
 
 
• **Custom grids:**
 
 
• Custom grids allow flexibility in organizing drawings.
 
• They are tailored to specific project requirements.
 
 
 
• **Geographic coordinate systems:**
 
 
• Used for mapping locations in relation to Earth's surface.
 
• Commonly applied in geospatial and civil engineering projects.
